name: NASA POWER
detail: Daily weather, previous five complete seasons; 24-hour cache. Historical data is never a forecast.

name: OpenLandMap
detail: Authorized GeoTIFF or Earth Engine export; local Python connector samples your polygon or radius.

name: ISRIC SoilGrids
detail: Official WCS / WebDAV raster workflow. The paused REST API is not used. Depth and units must be supplied.

name: ISRO EOS-04
detail: Official Bhoonidhi download requires registration. Import with date, units, scale and quality masking.

name: CGWB / NWIC
detail: Official station CSV imports and nearest-well distances. No borewell yield or exact farm water level is inferred.

name: Soil Health Card
detail: Enter lab results or import structured JSON and confirm. Automatic PDF/OCR extraction is not included.

name: Government APY
detail: District crop area/production exports feed the Python training pipeline. Evaluated models are required before prediction.
